text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: us-central1-gpu-hosts experiencing unexpected kernel oops and node reboots. Multiple pods evicted (~120) across 4 instances. Auto-eviction triggered. Paging oncall.

oncall_lucy: acked, I'm on it. Tailing node logs now. Will coordinate mitigation.

eli_sre: seeing elevated 5xx for generation endpoints — ~7-10% across the last 10m. Rolling error spikes line up with node reboots.

ashley_ng: Any customers impacted? Should we notify? :eyes: 

eli_sre: a few high-throughput tenants hit increased latency and retries; no complete data loss. Spike in retry budget usage. I'll paste session sample.

sam_platform: short-term mitigation: cordon the affected nodes and evict non-critical pods, increase fallback capacity to dedicated pool. Commands:

```
kubectl cordon gpu-host-5
kubectl drain gpu-host-5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
gcloud compute instances reset gpu-host-5 --zone us-central1-a
```

oncall_lucy: started cordon on gpu-host-5 and gpu-host-7. Evicting batch jobs.

eli_sre: sharing kernel messages from dmesg on gpu-host-5:

```
[ 10234.567890] NMI watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 22s
[ 10234.567900] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000010
[ 10234.567910] pcieport 0000:af:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: dev=0000:af:00.0
[ 10234.567920] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 79, pid=1234, gpu=0, reason: ECC error
```

eli_sre: also seeing repeated "AER: Corrected error" ~ every 10-30s before the crash.

sam_platform: ok that's interesting — repeated corrected PCIe AERs then kernel oops and NVRM Xid 79 (ECC). Could be hardware/firmware flakiness or driver regression.

mike_t: I'm joining. Have we ruled out noisy neighbor causing TLB pressure or memory ECC blasting? Any QoS changes or recent host image updates in the zone?

devops-bot: deploy: host-image-update completed on us-central1-a at 2026-03-15T01:12:30Z for nodes: gpu-host-2,gpu-host-3,gpu-host-5

oncall_lucy: that host-image-update looks suspicious — gpu-host-5 updated ~20m ago. timeline:
- 01:12 host-image-update started
- 01:30 first AER spike
- 01:40 kernel Oops and reboot

eli_sre: hypothesis list:
1) Host kernel or NVIDIA driver regression from host-image-update -> evidence: timing aligns.
2) Underlying hardware flake (PCIe/ECC) -> evidence: repeated AER and Xid 79.
3) Noisy neighbor (other vms hitting PCIe bus) -> weaker evidence.

oncall_lucy: action items while investigating:
- rollback host-image-update on unaffected nodes to reproduce? (sam)
- collect full dmesg + nvidia-smi -q outputs to support vendor RTC (mike)
- move critical traffic off affected hosts (ashley + prod routing)

sam_platform: rolling back host image won't be instant. For immediate, increase fallback to dedicated pool and enable autoplace to avoid us-central1-a.

ashley_ng: I'll draft customer comms: "We're investigating GPU host reboots affecting inference latency for some customers. Mitigations in progress. No data loss detected." Any objections?

mike_t: go ahead, mention ETA ~30-60m for mitigation, and we'll update.

eli_sre: attaching additional logs (excerpt):

```
Mar 15 01:40:12 gpu-host-5 kernel: Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0x10
Mar 15 01:40:12 gpu-host-5 nvidia: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 79
Mar 15 01:40:13 gpu-host-5 pcie: AER reported: syndrome=0x0, status=0x00000001
Mar 15 01:40:13 gpu-host-5 systemd: Rebooting.
```

oncall_lucy: I've asked GCP support to open a ticket and escalate to hardware team. Sharing ticket id when available.

mike_t: vendor escalation steps prepared. We need full kernel config + host image manifest. Sam, can you pull image manifest and kernel package versions?

sam_platform: pulling now. Also will snapshot instance disks and create serial console logs archive.

eli_sre: test idea: repro by running ECC stress test and PCIe stress on a warmed node — risky but could surface the bus fault. Suggest waiting for vendor guidance before destructive tests.

ashley_ng: customers asked for RCA window. Suggest we say: investigating, root cause under investigation, might be host-level kernel/driver/hardware. We'll update when vendor provides findings.

devops-bot: oncall_handoff: oncall_lucy -> mike_t at 01:58 UTC

oncall_lucy: handing off to mike_t (need to step out). Mike, see timeline & logs above. All mitigation steps kicked off.

mike_t: taking over. Sync notes:
- Nodes affected: gpu-host-5, gpu-host-7, gpu-host-9
- Evicted pods: ~120, primarily batch + some online replicas (autoscale handled most)
- Customer impact: transient 5xx spikes, increased retries, 3 customers reported degraded latency
- Immediate state: nodes cordoned, traffic shifted, GCP ticket opened

mike_t: tracking hypotheses in-thread with status tags:
[H1-driver/regression] status=investigating, evidence=timing with host-image-update
[H2-hw-ecc] status=investigating, evidence=AER/Xid79 in logs
[H3-noisy-neighbor] status=low-priority, evidence=none yet

eli_sre: adding additional signal: kernel oops stack points into nvidia kernel module. I can attach the stack trace to the ticket.

sam_platform: got host-image manifest: kernel v5.15.0-88, nvidia-driver 525.89.02, cloud-init 22.2.1

mike_t: next steps:
- Vendor support triage + log bundle (mike)
- Keep nodes cordoned and drain testable replicas to repro under controlled env (eli)
- Customer comms updates every 30m (ashley)

ashley_ng: posted comms to status page. Notified affected customers via email.

mike_t: if vendor confirms driver regression we'll plan an image rollback and controlled redeploy across zone. If hardware, GCP will replace hosts and we may need to onboard replacement nodes.

eli_sre: I'll attach a sanitized timeline for RCA doc. Example timeline entries:
- 01:12 host image update triggered
- 01:30 AER errors begin
- 01:40 kernel oops and auto-reboot
- 01:45 pods evicted and autoscale engaged
- 02:00 nodes cordoned and traffic shifted

oncall_lucy: leaving notes: full dmesg + nvidia-smi logs uploaded to /shipit/incidents/1819023456/logs

devops-bot: ticket created with GCP: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/CASE-20260315-0001

mike_t: updating incident channel with status: mitigated (traffic shifted), RCA in progress. Will assemble RCA doc once vendor responds. Closing live page but keeping thread open for RCA coordination.

ashley_ng: thanks team. We'll await vendor RCA. :thumbsup:
